scientific_review: Internal first pass reviewed carbon accounting, prenyltransferase versus TPS, class I/II cyclization, volatile and resin roles, sterol/saponin branch separation, carotenoid biochemistry and fluorescence, natural rubber stereochemistry and substrate use. Checked source metadata and corrected branch graphics; manually recalculated limiting substrates, NPQ, de-epoxidation index, carbon count, unsaturation, steady-state pool, kinetic comparisons, calibration and polymer calculations. Reviewed answer choices and explanations.
editorial_review: Separate second pass checked beginner-to-analytical progression, roadmap alignment, question rigor, answer shuffling, accessible figure labels, zoom targets and revision. Added landmark research and comparison tables; replaced overly simplistic reaction rows with directional flowcharts and corrected branch diagrams. Saved readback confirms 138 distinct teaching paragraphs, 50 four-choice questions with matching answers, and 13 labeled diagrams.
deductions: One point each for scientific simplifications and limited full-text checks; occasional dense/reiterated reasoning; schematic diagrams without rendered inspection; some straightforward distractors and no external question calibration; no actual interactive/mobile/screen-reader testing. Internal self-assessment, not independent review.
